notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Arcbound Crusher triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arcbound Crusher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos, as well as sacrifice Arcbound Crusher to Krark-Clan Ironworks to put its +1/+1 counters on any artifact creature you control.
